## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue if there is one.

## Validation

List the checks run and their results. For appearance changes, include a real GPU
capture. For generated builds, include a CPU preview and regenerate the affected
`.octa` files at default density.

## Documentation and assets

Mention changed controls, contracts, or public types and their documentation.
Identify the source and license of any new external assets or copied code.
